claim_boundary: This manifest is a normalization preflight only. It accepts no estimator policy, finite-size exponent rerun, material validation, RG closure, universality shift, or Tier A upgrade.

preflight_decision.reason: The q-grid convention can be stated in lattice units, but field normalization, source coefficient mapping, xi extraction, and finite-size admissibility remain open before estimator acceptance.

missing_for_acceptance: source normalization of c_A must be matched to UET C range and centering policy
ensemble or time-averaging convention must be declared before S(q,t) is accepted
field_normalization.proposed_mapping: Use centered dimensionless UET order parameter as a diagnostic concentration-fluctuation field.
field_normalization.source_symbol: delta c or normalized concentration fluctuation in S(q,t)

draft_rule: exclude domain-scale saturated modes before exponent fitting
require at least three accepted grid sizes
require stable or increasing absolute length under accepted estimator
missing_for_acceptance: numeric q-band bounds are not yet derived from source or accepted simulations
accepted-grid rule has not been rerun with a source-backed estimator

fourier_convention.normalization_note: This closes the q-grid convention only; it does not accept an estimator.
fourier_convention.proposed_mapping: Use NumPy FFT lattice wave numbers with dx declared by the simulation grid.

required_before_rerun: implement candidate estimator in a verifier separate from the rejected RMS inverse-k proxy
emit per-grid q-window diagnostics and exclusion reasons
compare against baseline and prior estimator lanes without promoting either by default
rerun finite-size/exponent gates only after normalization and admissibility gates pass

missing_for_acceptance: no source-locked mapping from Longo coefficients to UETParameters
no policy for setting interconversion terms when the current conserved-order lane omits them
no chi(q=0) curvature/susceptibility estimate accepted for conserved-mean fields
derive a source-backed finite-k characteristic length from S(q,t)
avoid empirical calibration factors unless source-backed
demonstrate nondeclining absolute length across accepted grid sizes
xi_extraction_rule.rejected_proxy: current all-nonzero-mode RMS inverse-k proxy remains diagnostic-only
xi_extraction_rule.source_basis: finite-k S(q,t) and characteristic wave-number behavior
